dedupe_keys.name: eia annual energy outlook aeo us energy projections to 2050 with side cases

description: The Annual Energy Outlook presents the assessment by the U.S. Energy Information Administration of the outlook for US energy markets through 2050. The edition read, AEO2026, was released on 8 April 2026, with the next due in 2027. It provides a counterfactual baseline case and side cases, each as data tables in Excel, an interactive table viewer and the EIA API, with a narrative covering transportation, electricity, oil and natural gas and technologies, an assumptions report, case descriptions and fact sheets, for example on modelling international LNG capacity, electricity load and demand, and hydrocarbon production data. Coverage is the United States. Tables are free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: projections depend on the stated assumptions and policy at the time of each edition and are not forecasts of what will happen. Simulation uses are long-term demand and capacity trajectories for infrastructure planning and scenario-based stress testing. Related records: data-eia-short-term-energy-outlook gives monthly 18-month forecasts.
